description_short: The NERC GW4+ Doctoral Landscape Training Partnership, United Kingdom, invites applications for PhD projects starting September 2027. Applicants may apply for one project only across the partnership; the deadline is 23:59 GMT on 7 January 2027, with interviews notified from 15 February 2027.
